'''January 2000 Rochester tournament (15 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Rochester, NY on 15 January 2000. Charles won it. It is known from R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d181">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-16-rochester-ny-1-15-2000d181/ rochester-ny-1-15-2000], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 16 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-16-rochester-ny-1-15-2000d181/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Rochester, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 19
* '''Winner:''' Charles
